title: watchDeployment
summary: Recover stale production navigation without adding code to the core router.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass a Smolter navigation or data router and DeploymentOptions from virtual:smolter/deployment. Null metadata is a no-op for development and SSR. Install once before starting a manual router, or pass deployment metadata directly to mountApplication so recovery also covers the initial route import.

sections.title: Result and disposal
sections.body: Returns a cleanup function. Cleanup removes the popstate and Vite listeners, aborts a pending manifest request and restores router methods. router.dispose() also calls cleanup.

sections.title: Navigation behavior
sections.body: Pathname and query navigation checks the no-store manifest, including Back/Forward. Confirmed build changes reload the destination with its query and hash; hash-only or external links do not check. Concurrent requests share a probe and only the latest navigation may reload. Mutations are never replayed.

sections.title: Failures and cache policy
sections.body: Network errors, bad JSON and timeouts fall back to normal navigation. A session marker limits recovery to one reload per old build/manifest URL. Blocked storage disables automatic reload. Serve the manifest with no-store and HTML with no-cache. A custom reload callback owns confirmation/navigation and receives the destination URL.
